# Breakdown

Three bars that split load into intrinsic, extraneous and germane, each with a one-line plain-English explanation.

`CLR.Breakdown` · Live state

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.Breakdown intrinsic={0} extraneous={0} germane={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.Breakdown" intrinsic="{{0}}" extraneous="{{0}}" germane="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (BreakdownProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `intrinsic` * | `number` | How hard the task itself is (errors, typing variance). 0–1. |
| `extraneous` * | `number` | Distraction and switching (tab and window churn). 0–1. |
| `germane` * | `number` | Productive effort (sustained engagement). 0–1. |
| `compact` | `boolean` | Hide the one-line explanations (extension popup, sidebar). |
| `uncertain` | `boolean` | Show the "Rough" badge and dim the bars when confidence < 0.5. |
